subject: [PATCH v5 6/9] mm/collapse: drop the collapse_possible() wrapper

reviews.author: Lance Yang
reviews.summary: Provided a Reviewed-by tag without any comments or suggestions.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, Oct 14, 2026 at 06:11:39PM +0100, Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta) wrote:
>collapse_possible() only forwards to collapse_possible_orders() and turns
>its mask into a bool.  Its three callers can test the mask themselves.
>
>No functional change.
>
>Assisted-by: LLM
>Acked-by: David Hildenbrand (Arm) <david@kernel.org>
>Reviewed-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>
>Reviewed-by: Baolin Wang <baolin.wang@linux.alibaba.com>
>Signed-off-by: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta) <kas@kernel.org>

Reviewed-by: Lance Yang <lance.yang@linux.dev>

2026-10-15.patch_summary: This patch removes the unnecessary collapse_possible() wrapper function, which simply forwards to collapse_possible_orders(). The three callers of collapse_possible() can now directly test the mask themselves.
